title: 借光岛 / Borrowed Light Island
notes: All models original, procedurally authored in Blender.
Lamp heads and light beams intentionally supplied by Unity.
Cabin_ReadingWindow_Glow is separately named for runtime material control.
FBX/GLB retain named component meshes and anchor empties.
Anchors, route corridors, buildings and interaction footprints remain Y=0; planted banks have smooth -3.5cm to +11.5cm humps.
revision: world-v7-candidate: broad restrained Hero fracture planes
design_changes: Load frozen world-v6; only four Hero rock upper vertices, custom corner normals and quiet linear vertex tint change.
Hero upper surfaces recede within the old actual projected footprint; lower rim, all 28 other mesh geometry/colour/UV/material fingerprints and 14 anchors are unchanged.
No random displacement, new texture, material or renderer. One partial shallow bedding step per rock. Render mesh collision is changed locally inward and must be runtime-tested.

vertex_colors.purpose: quiet mineral and restrained layer tint; no random noise

preview_scope: 512px, six-sample CPU Blender form inspections only; Unity material and collision review still required.
